item.title: NetworkX Test
item.description: Once again, I was playing around with Jupyter. This time I was more interested in seeing how it handled NetworkX. It seemed to work fairly well, though the kernel died using above 500 connected nodes.

item.title: Jupyter Test
item.description: I was playing around with Jupyter, namely its feature that allows exporting as a markdown file, and since this site is built with Hugo, a static HTML generator that translates markdown, I thought I’d see what the results looked like.
